<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="15" x2="331" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="13" x2="339" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="11" x2="347" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="355" y1="18" x2="363" y2="18" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="369" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="371" y="10" width="13" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="388" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,58 23,64 31,70" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="64" x2="42" y2="64" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="67" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Travel setup</text>
  <circle cx="361" cy="63" r="11" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="361" y="68" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">?</text>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <rect x="24" y="99" width="342" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
  <rect x="24" y="99" width="114" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
  <text x="350" y="122" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">1 of 3</text>

  <!-- Welcome prompt -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="137" width="340" height="86" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="25" y="135" width="340" height="86" rx="14" fill="#15451F"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="178" r="25" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="172" r="3" fill="#15451F"/>
    <circle cx="67" cy="172" r="3" fill="#15451F"/>
    <line x1="52" y1="187" x2="66" y2="187" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="96" y="169" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">LET’S DO IT!</text>
    <text x="96" y="192" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Tell us about your next trip.</text>
    <text x="96" y="211" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">We’ll personalize your lessons.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Question -->
  <text x="25" y="262" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Where are you going?</text>
  <text x="25" y="289" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Choose a destination to get started.</text>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <text x="25" y="327" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Destination</text>
  <rect x="24" y="338" width="342" height="58" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="24" y="336" width="342" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="364" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="58" y1="371" x2="65" y2="378" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="78" y="371" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Paris, France</text>
  <text x="25" y="417" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change this later in your settings.</text>

  <!-- Destination preview card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="444" width="342" height="114" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="24" y="442" width="342" height="114" rx="14" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- French flag -->
    <rect x="44" y="466" width="70" height="52" rx="11" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="44" y="466" width="23.3" height="52" rx="10" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <rect x="67.3" y="466" width="23.4" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="90.7" y="466" width="23.3" height="52" rx="10" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <text x="132" y="476" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">YOUR TRIP</text>
    <text x="132" y="501" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">France</text>
    <text x="132" y="526" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">French travel lessons</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Quick choices -->
  <text x="25" y="590" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Popular destinations</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="606" width="101" height="36" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="75" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Paris</text>
    <rect x="136" y="606" width="101" height="36" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="186" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Nice</text>
    <rect x="247" y="606" width="118" height="36" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="306" y="629" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Lyon</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue area -->
  <line x1="24" y1="665" x2="366" y2="665" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="25" y="690" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Enter a destination to continue</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="703" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="733" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#E5E5E5" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Learn -->
    <polygon points="39,790 51,780 63,790" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="43" y="789" width="16" height="13" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="51" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Learn</text>
    <!-- Practice -->
    <circle cx="132" cy="789" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="126" y1="789" x2="138" y2="789" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="783" x2="132" y2="795" stroke="#1899D6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="132" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1899D6">Practice</text>
    <!-- Friends -->
    <circle cx="215" cy="786" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="215" cy="799" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="230" cy="788" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="218" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Friends</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="307" cy="786" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="307" cy="799" rx="11" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="307" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
